Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • EM 385-1-1 8 Hour Refresher Training for Site Safety and Health Officers (SSHOs): in compliance with the Revised USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024) safety Standards.
  • EM 385-1-1 8-Hour Refresher Training For Workers: in compliance with the Revised USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024) safety Standards.
  • EM 385-1-1 16-Hour Training for Workers: in compliance with the Revised USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024) safety Standards.
  • EM 385-1-1 24 Hour Training: in compliance with the Revised USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024) Safety Standard.
  • EM 385-1-1 40 Hour Training: in compliance with the Revised USACE EM 385-1-1 (2024) Safety Standards.
How long does EM 385-1-1 Training take?
  • EM 385-1-1 8 Hour Refresher Training for Site Safety and Health Officers (SSHOs): 8 hours.
  • EM 385-1-1 8-Hour Refresher Training For Workers: 8 hours.
  • EM 385-1-1 16-Hour Training for Workers: 16 hours.
  • EM 385-1-1 24 Hour Training: 24 hours.
  • EM 385-1-1 40 Hour Training: 40 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • EM 385-1-1 8 Hour Refresher Training for Site Safety and Health Officers (SSHOs): valid 12 months
  • EM 385-1-1 8-Hour Refresher Training For Workers: valid 12 months
  • EM 385-1-1 16-Hour Training for Workers: valid 12 months
  • EM 385-1-1 24 Hour Training: valid 36 months
  • EM 385-1-1 40 Hour Training: valid 12 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

Yes. All 5 courses are available in English and Spanish.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
